subject: Creating a pdf with relative links to plots

messages.author: 982b20aee572e891
messages.subject: Creating a pdf with relative links to plots
parts:
I'm trying to create a pdf document using knitr (& Rstudio) that will include hyperlinks to plots.

The links work with absolute addresses but fail with the error "The link 'file://./XXXXXX.pdf”  cannot be opened because the destination file cannot be found.' (From OSX Preview PDF viewer) when I try a relative address. 

Any pointers to where I'm going wrong greatly appreciated.

Small example appended.

Thanks

Ian




---
title: "hyperlink_test"
author: "Ian Handel"
date: "16 June 2015"
output: pdf_document
---


```{r, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
library(knitr)

link <- "histogram.pdf"

pdf((link), height = 6, width = 6)
hist(rnorm(1000))
dev.off()

kable(data.frame(link = paste0("file://./", link)))
```
